stem_book: What is the general solution of the equation a sin x + b cos x = 0? (a) x = nπ ± tan⁻¹(b/a) (b) x = nπ + cot⁻¹(b/a) (c) x = 2nπ + tan⁻¹(b/a) (d) x = nπ ± cot⁻¹(a/b)
reason: tan x = −b/a ⇒ x = nπ − tan⁻¹(b/a); key (a) adds a spurious '+' branch, and (d) nπ ± cot⁻¹(a/b) is the same set as (a) — no printed option is exactly correct.
work: a sin x = −b cos x ⇒ tan x = −b/a ⇒ x = nπ + tan⁻¹(−b/a) = nπ − tan⁻¹(b/a)
